_comment: Tier-2 for kratos poisson: FALSIFIES the pre-2026-08-03 catalog claim 'Properties (CONDUCTIVITY, DENSITY, SPECIFIC_HEAT) go on Properties object, NOT on nodes'. On Kratos 10.4.0 LaplacianElement2D3N reads the diffusivity NODALLY via ConvectionDiffusionSettings.GetDiffusionVariable; the Properties value is ignored. Swap test reading LHS[0][0]: nodal 1 + Properties 1 -> 1.0; nodal 1 + Properties 999 -> 1.0; nodal 999 + Properties 1 -> 999.0. This also resolves a direct contradiction inside the catalog: KNOWLEDGE['curved_mms'] pitfall #1 said nodal (right), KNOWLEDGE['poisson'] said Properties (wrong). Verified by execution 2026-08-03. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 sets the NODAL conductivity to 1.0 in the probe that is supposed to raise it to 999, so nodal and property values no longer disagree; the stiffness entry that reads 999.0 collapses to the base value. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: nodal_conductivity_drives_diffusion=True, lhs00_prop1_nodal999=999.0. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/cda_conductivity_is_nodal && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails).
